objective: Restore visible Matthew Henry while scrolling Bible and remove oversized nested horizontal verse padding shown on Android; avoid daily reading, AdMob and navigation regressions.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main after Nov16 staging PR #868 merge 81c0e78518f05518fa9ad4036756fd0ca2f014f6; published staging-user Android 1.3.2 update 01a1e27b-0009-7e15-a0fd-e2207701a55e; production previously update 01a1e10a-f043-7113-9a6c-673e91a58517. This DEV must be staged and server-verified before subsequent production publication.
chosenApproach: Add compact persistent Matthew Henry access in free Bible, select only verified commentary/context/introduction, and reduce padding of Bible-specific verse container without changing global cards.
selectionRationale: Current per-verse Henry links disappear when source lacks direct verse records and chapter controls scroll away. Global style changes would break unrelated screens; a scoped floating action with truthfully labeled chapter content solves the screenshot issue.
alternativeApproaches: Show a large commentary link after every verse (rejected: overwhelming repeated controls and false direct coverage).
Remove global UI Card padding everywhere (rejected: breaks layouts outside Bible).
preserveBehaviors: Bible content, source fidelity, personal notes, highlight and completion unchanged.
Daily Plan separate from full Bible, narration and audio settings unaffected.
Matthew Henry not fabricated for uncovered verse; context and introductions clearly labeled.
No AdMob, native/runtime, Supabase, auth or bottom-navigation modifications.
acceptanceChecks: Bible reader shows persistent Matthew Henry entry during scroll with accessible label.
Direct commentary, related context and introductions are distinct and testable.
Bible verse reading becomes nearly edge-to-edge but safe-bottom, zoom and tap actions remain.
Verify focused tests, TypeScript and Android compilation before separate staging OTA; owner physical-device verification skipped.
